d: Merlina and Doralba who anguish Don Crisobolo while Gelindo is intent on writing his music at the table.

View of the pier. In the distance anchored ship. Above small palisket Fiordispina, and Don Perizionio, who arrives at the shore. On one side external appearance of the castle with poplars, and on the other buildings. Fiordispina, and Don Perizionio, ind. Don Crisobolo.
Room of the inn, where Merlina and Doralba stay. Merlina and Doralba, indi Gelindo.
Gallery in the house of Don Crisobolo. Don Crisobolo and Fiordispina indi Perizionio, and Gelindo.
Gallery as above. Fiordispina, and Perizionio, indi don Crisobolo.
View of the pier, as before. Merlina, and Gelindo, indi don Perizionio.
